PF.43817/D.S.9.a.

8th July, 1935.

Dear Major Vivian,

I am sending the enclosed copy of a translation of a letter to HODANN on the bare chance that it may be of interest to you.

We have no record of SANDELMANN.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) R. H. H. S.

Major V. Vivian, C.B.E., S.I.S.
